### Introduction:

Special thanks to: https://github.com/rgrp for sharing the dataset.

### Step 1. Import the necessary libraries

```{r step1, message=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
```

### Step 2. Import the dataset from this [address](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasets/investor-flow-of-funds-us/f9258c2703085a686c330f2d0a0b41c818a9b112/data/weekly.csv).

(The current version of that dataset has changed; this link points to the 2015 version used by the exercise.
The same file is also included in this folder as `weekly.csv`.)

### Step 3. Assign it to a variable called df

```{r}
url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datasets/investor-flow-of-funds-us/f9258c2703085a686c330f2d0a0b41c818a9b112/data/weekly.csv"

# we read Date as text on purpose, to convert it ourselves later
df <- read_csv(url, col_types = cols(Date = col_character(), .default = col_double()))
head(df)
```

### Step 4. What is the frequency of the dataset?

```{r}
# weekly data: most consecutive dates are 7 days apart
ymd(df$Date) |> diff() |> table()
```

### Step 5. Set the column Date as the index.

```{r}
# tibbles have no index: we keep Date as the first column
df <- df |> relocate(Date)
head(df)
```

### Step 6. What is the type of the index?

```{r}
class(df$Date)
# it is a 'character' type
```

### Step 7. Set the index to a Date type

```{r}
df <- df |> mutate(Date = ymd(Date))
class(df$Date)
```

### Step 8. Change the frequency to monthly, sum the values and assign it to monthly.

```{r}
monthly <- df |>
  group_by(Date = floor_date(Date, "month")) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), sum))

# pandas' resample() also creates the months without data.
# In R we can add them explicitly with complete():
monthly <- monthly |>
  complete(Date = seq(min(Date), max(Date), by = "month"))

monthly
```

### Step 9. You will notice that it filled the dataFrame with months that don't have any data with NA. Let's drop these rows.

```{r}
monthly <- monthly |> drop_na()
monthly
```

### Step 10. Good, now we have the monthly data. Now change the frequency to year.

```{r}
year <- monthly |>
  group_by(Date = floor_date(Date, "year")) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), sum))
year
```
